geometry.extract:
let image = try Hokusai(url: URL(fileURLWithPath: "scene.png"))

// Coordinates count from the top-left corner of the image *as it is at this point*.
try await image
    .extract(x: 1000, y: 120, width: 400, height: 560)
    .png()
    .write(to: URL(fileURLWithPath: "lighthouse.png"))

// After a resize, the same numbers address a different part of the picture.
try await image
    .resize(width: 800)
    .extract(x: 1000 / 2, y: 120 / 2, width: 400 / 2, height: 560 / 2)
    .png()
    .write(to: URL(fileURLWithPath: "lighthouse-after-resize.png"))
runtime.capabilities:
let capabilities = try Hokusai.capabilities()
print("libvips", capabilities.libvipsVersion, "· Cairo", capabilities.cairoVersion)
print("can read :", capabilities.inputFormats.map(\.rawValue).sorted().joined(separator: ", "))
print("can write:", capabilities.outputFormats.map(\.rawValue).sorted().joined(separator: ", "))
print("text rendering:", capabilities.textRendering, "· HEIF codecs:",
      capabilities.heifCompressions.map { "\($0)" }.sorted().joined(separator: ", "), "· PNG palette:", capabilities.pngPalette)
text.draw:
let photo = try Hokusai(url: URL(fileURLWithPath: "scene.png")).resize(width: 640)

var style = TextStyle(font: "sans Bold", fontSize: 40, color: .white)
style.shadow = TextShadow(offsetX: 2, offsetY: 2, blur: 2, color: Color(red: 0, green: 0, blue: 0, opacity: 0.7))

try await photo
    .drawText("Pharos Point", placement: .gravity(.southWest, offsetX: 24, offsetY: 20), style: style)
    .webp(quality: 88)
    .write(to: URL(fileURLWithPath: "caption.webp"))
